paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai thu tengteng agen khit in, anungzuite kiang ah,
heading: Jesu Thah Sawmna / (Mar 14.1-2; Luk 22.1-2; Joh 11.46-53)
english: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,

paite: "Ni nih nung chiang in Paikan Ankuangluina ahong om ding chih na thei ua, Mihing Tapa kilhden ding in amansak ding uh," achi hi.
english: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”

paite: Huai lai in siampu lianpen Kaiapha achih uh huangsung ah siampu liante leh vantang upate akikhawm uhi.
english: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

paite: Jesu khem a mat a, ahihlup theihna ding un akikum uhi.
english: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

paite: Himahleh, "Ankuanglui ni in hi keileh, huchi lou in zaw vantang lak ah buaina ahong piang kha ding," achi uhi.
english: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

paite: Bethani khua a, miphak Simon inn a Jesu a-om lai in,
heading: Bethani Khua A Jesu Thaunilhna / (Mar 14.3-9; Joh 12.1-8)
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

paite: numei khat alabaster bawm a thau gimlim mantam tawi in, akiang ah ahong pai a, an a-um lai in alu ah asung hi.
english: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

paite: Himahleh nungzuite'n huai amuh un aheh ua, "Bangziak a hichibang a hihmangthang mawkmawk ahia?
english: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

paite: Hiai thau mantam tampi a zuak a, mizawngte kiang a piak theih ahi ngal a," achi uhi.
english: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”

paite: Jesu'n huai atheih in, akiang uah, "Bangziak a numei hihbuai na hi ua? Ka tung ah thil hoihtak ahih ahi.
english: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.

paite: Mizawngte tangtawn a na kiang ua om ahi kei hiam, kei bel tangtawn a na kiang ua om ka hi kei hi.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.

paite: Hiai thau gimlim ka sa a asun, vui ding a hon bawl ding in ahih ahi.
english: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, khovel tengteng ah koi ah leng hiai tanchinhoih agenna peuh uah hiai numei thilhih leng amah theihgigena ding in agen zel ding uh," achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”

paite: Huai nung in sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, Judas Iskariot achih uh, siampu liante kiang ah ahoh a;
heading: Judas Iskariot Muanhuai Louhna / (Mar 14.10,11; Luk 22.3-6)
english: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

paite: "Amah hon mansak leng, bang na hon pe ding ua?" achi hi. Huchi in dangka sawmthum abuksakta uhi.
english: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

paite: Huai nung siah zuausan a matsakna ding hunlem azongta hi.
english: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

paite: Huan Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh ani masapen in Jesu kiang ah nungzuite ahong ua, "Paikan Ankuanglui nekna ding koi lai ah hon bawlsak le ung na ut a?" achi uhi.
heading: Paikan Ankuang Umna / (Mar 14.12-21; Luk 22.7-13; 22.21-23; Joh 13.1-30)
english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

paite: Ama'n, "Khopi ah kuahiam kiang ah hoh unla, akiang ah, 'Sinsakpa'n, ka hun anaita a; na inn ah nungzuite toh Paikan Ankuang ka um ding uh e' achi, va chi un,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ua achih bang in nungzuite'n ahih ua; Paikan Ankuang abawlta uhi.
english: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

paite: Huai ni nitaklam in, nungzui sawm-le-nihte toh an a-um uhi.
english: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

paite: An anek lai un, ama'n, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na lak ua mi khat in kei ahon mansak ding,” achi hi.
english: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

paite: Huchi in alungkham mahmah ua, akiang ah, "Toupa, kei ka hi maw?" achi chiat uhi.
english: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

paite: Ama'n, "Ankuang hon sawkpihpa ngei in kei hon zuausan in hon mansak ding achi hi.
english: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

paite: Mihing Tapa tanchin agelh bang un apai ding hi. Himahleh, Mihing Tapa mansak dingpa tung agik hi; huai mipa zaw piang keileh amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

paite: Huan amansak dingpa Judas in adong a, "Heutupa, keimah ka hi maw?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hi e,” achi hi.
english: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”

paite: Huan an anek lai un Jesu'n tanghou ala a, avualzawl khit in, abalkham a; nungzuite kiang ah apia a, "La unla, ne un; hiai ka pumpi ahi," achi hi.
heading: Nitak Ankuang Nanung / (Mar 14.10,11; Luk 22.14-20; 1 Kor 11.23-25)
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”

paite: Huai zoh in nou leng la a, kipahthu agen khit in, akiang uah apia a, "Na vek un dawn un;
english: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,

paite: hiai ka sisan a thukhun thak, khelhnate ngaihdamna dia mi tampi a dia pawt ding ahi.
english: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

paite: Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, ka Pa gam a noute toh athak ka dawn ni atun masiah tuban grepgui gahtui ka dawn nawnta kei ding," achi hi.
english: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan la asak zoh un apawt ua, Olive tang ah apaita uhi.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

paite: Jesu'n amau kiang ah, "Tuzan chiang in na vek un ka tungthu a lungkia in na hon taisan vek ding uh; 'Belamchingpa ka zep ding a, belamhonte adalh ding uh' chih gelh bang in.
heading: Jesu'n Nungzuite Taihsan Ding Thu Agenkhol / (Mar 14.27-31; Luk 22.31-34; Joh 13.36-38)
english: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

paite: "Himahleh ka thohnawn nung in Galili gam ah na ma uah ka pai ding," achi hi.
english: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Avek un na tungthu ah lungkia in om mah le uh kei zaw lungkia in ka om kei hial ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, tuzan in ak khuan ma in, nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Na sihna a leng si sam ding himah leng ka hon kitheihmohbawl kei hial ding," achi a. Huchibang mah in nungzuite'n leng achi chiat uhi.
english: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.

paite: Huai zoh in amau toh mun khat Gethsemani achih uh atung ua; anungzuite kiang ah, "Pam a ka va thum kal in hiai ah na tu un," achi hi.
heading: Jesu, Gethsemani Huan Ah / (Mar 14.32-42; Luk 22.39-46)
english: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

paite: Peter leh Zebedai tapate nih api a, alungkham in ahong mangbang mahmahta hi.
english: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Ka kha alungkham mahmah a, sihna khop hial ahi; hiai ah om unla, hon venpih un," achi hi.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”

paite: Neukha in malam ah ava pai zek a, bokkhup in, "Ka Pa aw, ahihtheihleh hiai nou in hon pel mahmah hen; himahleh kei thu hilou in, nang thuthu hi zaw hen," chi in athum hi.
english: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

paite: Huan nungzuite kiang ah ahong pai a, amaute ihmu in ahong mu a, Peter kiang ah, "Nou dakkal khat lel leng hon hahpih zou lou na hi uh maw?
english: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

paite: Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un kiging gige in thum un; kha in zaw angap a, sa bel ahat kei," achi hi.
english: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

paite: Nihveina ah ava pai a, athum nawn a, "Ka Pa aw, ka dawn louh a hiai nou in ahon pelh theih keileh nangmah thuthu hi hen," achi hi.
english: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

paite: Ahong pai nawn a, amaute ihmu in ahong mu nawn hi; a-ihmut uh asuah mahmah ziak in.
english: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

paite: Huan apaisan nawn a, athumveina ah agen ngei gen in athum nawn hi.
english: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

paite: Huai khit in nungzuite kiang ah ahong pai nawn a, akiang uah, "Na ihmu lailai uh maw, na tawlnga lailai uh maw? Ngai dih uh, ahun ahong tungta, mikhialte khut ah Mihing Tapa khot khit ahita.
english: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

paite: Thou unla, pai ni, en dih uh, hon mansak dingpa ahong naita," achi hi.
english: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

paite: Huan agen lai mah in Judas, sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, siampu liante leh laigelhmite leh upate kiang a kipan mipi tampitak leh namsau leh khetbukte toh ahong tung hi.
heading: Jesu Matna / (Mar 14.43-50; Luk 22.47-53; Joh 18.3-12)
english: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

paite: Amansak ding pa'n chiamtehna ding ahilhkhol sipsip a, "Ka tawp penpen amah na man ding uh," chi in.
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu ava naih a, "Chibai, Heutupa," chi in atawp hi.
english: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Lawm, na hong nangawn hih in," achi hi. Huaitak in, Jesu alen ua, amanta uh.
english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

paite: Huan ngai dih, Jesu ompihte lak a khat in akhut zankhia in anamsau adokkhia a, siampu lianpen sikha aban a, abil abankhiaksak hi.
english: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na namsau akoihna ah koih nawn in; namsau pan peuhmah namsau mah a asih ding ziak in.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

paite: Ka Pa ngen leng angel sangguk mun sawm-le-nih hon sawl pah ding ahi; ngen thei lou in na hon ngaihtuah ua hia?
english: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

paite: Himahleh, ngen leng bangchi in ahia Laisiangthou in hichibang a hong om ding achihte atangtun theih ding?" achi hi.
english: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”

paite: Huai laitak in Jesu'n mipite kiang ah, "Namsaute, khetbukte tawi in suamhat man ding bang in keimah man ding a hong pawt na hi uh maw? Tempul ah niteng in thuhilh in ka tu a, na hon man ngal kei uhi.
english: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

paite: Himahleh zawlnei Laisiangthou thute atunkimna dia hiai tengteng hong tungta ei ve," achi hi. Huchi in nungzui tengteng in amah anusia ua, ataimangta uhi.
english: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.

paite: Jesu mante'n siampu lianpen Kaiapha inn a, laigelhmite leh upate omkhawmna ah amah apita uhi.
heading: Siampu Lianpen Mai A Jesu Dinna / (Mar 14.53-65; Luk 22.54,55,63-67; Joh 18.13-14,19-24)
english: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

paite: Himahleh Peter in gamlatak ah siampu lianpen huangsung tan in amah zui in ava lut a, atawpna tan thei ding in sikhate lak ah ava tu hi.
english: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

paite: Amah ahihlup theihna ding un siampu liante leh vaihawmte tengteng in Jesu hekna ding azong uhi.
english: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

paite: Theihpih taklou tampi toh hong pai mah le uh ngohna ding bangmah amu thei kei uhi. Aden chiang in mi nih ahong pai ua,
english: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward

paite: hiai mipa'n, "Tempul hihsia a, ni thum sung a lam nawn thei ka hi, achi,” achi uhi.
english: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”

paite: Huchi in siampu lianpen adingtou a, akiang ah, "Bangmah adawng lou ding maw? Hiaite hon hekna bangchidan ahia?” achi hi.
english: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”

paite: Jesu bel adai dide hi. Huan siampu lianpen in akiang ah, "Pathian hing min in ka hon ngen ahi, Khrist, Pathian Tapa na hi hia? Hon hilh in," achi hi.
english: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hi e, himahleh, ka hon hilh ahi, tunung chiang in Mihing Tapa thilhihtheihna taklam a tu a, van meipi tung a hong pai na mu ding uh," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”

paite: Huan siampu lianpen in apuansilh abotkek a, "Pathian agenseta e! Theihpih dang bang i kiphamoh nawn dia? Ngai dih uh, Pathian agensiatdan tu in na zata uh. Bangchi na sa ua?" achi hi.
english: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

paite: Amaute'n, "Si tak ahi," chi in adawng uhi. 67 Huan amai ah chil aphih ua, atum ua; khenkhat in akhutpek ua beng in,
english: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”

paite: "Nang Khrist, kua ahia hon tum hon hilh in?" achi uhi.
english: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

paite: Vaihawmna huangsung polam ah Peter atu a; nungaknou khat akiang ah ahong pai a, "Nang leng Galili gam a mi, Jesu kiang a om na hi ve," achi hi.
heading: Peter In Jesu Kitheihmohbawl / (Mar 14.66-72; Luk 22.56-62; Joh 18.15-18,25-27)
english: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

paite: Ama'n bel, "Na thugen ka thei kei," chi in avek ua ma ah akitheihmohbawl hi.
english: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”

paite: Huan inlim a apawttak in nungak dang in amah amu a, huai a omte kiang ah, "Hiai mi Nazaret Jesu kiang a ompa ahi," achi hi.
english: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”

paite: Peter kichiam in, "Huai mipa ka thei kha kei," chi in kitheihmohbawl nawn hi.
english: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

paite: Peter kichiam in, "Huai mipa ka thei kha kei," chi in kitheihmohbawl nawn hi.
english: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”

paite: Huan sawt lou nung in, akiang a dinghte'n Peter kiang ah, "Nang leng alak ua mi na hi vo oi, na pau ah akithei," achi uhi.
english: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”

paite: Ama'n bel huai mipa ka thei kha kei, chi in hamsia kiloh in akichiamta hi. Huchi in ak akhuang pah ngal hi.
english: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.

paite: Huan Peter in, "Jesu'n ak akhuan ma in nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," chi a akiang a athugen aphawkkhia a, apawtkhia a, akap huphup hi.
english: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.
